trello.name: Sign venue contract and confirm AV recording
trello.desc: Diego to get the convention center contract through legal review and signed by end of next week. Confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall plus two breakout rooms), not main-hall only as happened last year.

trello.name: Lock speaker lineup to nine confirmed speakers
trello.desc: Bo to send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If either declines, fill from the backup list of five names. Commitment is to have the full lineup of nine locked within two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: Bo to chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week. The abstract is needed for the website and the printed program.

trello.name: Draft and schedule three-wave email campaign
trello.desc: Diego to draft all three email campaign waves this month: (1) agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup, (2) early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, (3) final-week push. First wave goes out the day the agenda is live.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots for website update
trello.desc: Once the lineup locks, Bo to hand speaker bios and headshots straight to Diego same day for the landing page update. Needed before wave one of the email campaign.

trello.name: Approve and place swag order
trello.desc: Camille to review the swag design proofs in the shared drive today. Once approved, Diego to place the order this week for 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers (approx. 9,200 with rush buffer). Lead time was six weeks last year, already cutting it close.
